biggest_gap: Character integration into scenes. The reference places the stickman WITHIN environmental contexts — standing on planetary surfaces, spatially positioned relative to celestial bodies — where his facial expression reads against the scene itself. Ours consistently separates the stickman as a left-margin observer who comments on a diagram positioned to his right. The Paint Explainer style embeds the character in the world being explained, not beside it as an external narrator. The stickman should inhabit the space, not watch it from outside the frame.
